download_s2ef_data: run the script to download and preprocess an S2EF dataset split like 200k or val_id
download_is2re_data: run the script to download and extract the IS2RE train val test dataset
run_get_data: run get_data to download extract and preprocess data for a specified task and split
run_uncompress_data: run uncompress_data to decompress a compressed S2EF data directory using the uncompress module
run_preprocess_data: run preprocess_data to transform uncompressed S2EF data into the output path using preprocess_ef
